status_definitions.implemented: Exposed and mechanically enforced for the current supported level/scope.
status_definitions.partial: Exposed and partially enforced, but missing at least one meaningful rules interaction.
status_definitions.deferred: Exposed or planned in text/data, but intentionally not yet runtime-enforced.
status_definitions.not_exposed: Tracked for future completeness, but not currently exposed to public play.

attack.implementation: Server-owned combat attack resolution spends the Action while leaving the rest of the player turn available.

dash.implementation: Dash spends an Action and grants extra movement equal to Speed for the current turn.

disengage.implementation: Disengage spends an Action and suppresses Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the current turn.

dodge.implementation: Dodge can impose disadvantage on creature attacks.

grapple.implementation: Grapple uses Attack action option and target save.

help.implementation: Help spends the Action and stores one-use Advantage for matching attack or check handoffs; full multiplayer ally turns and richer task targeting remain incomplete.

hide.implementation: Hide uses the fixed DC 15 Stealth check, applies server-owned Hidden state on success, grants attack Advantage, imposes attack Disadvantage against the hidden character, and clears on attacks/spells; full cover, line-of-sight, and map visibility remain incomplete.

influence.implementation: Prompts social checks and persists one-target NPC attitude/leverage state on resolution; group attitudes, complex faction clocks, and long-term relationship decay remain incomplete.

magic.implementation: Spell casting uses a server-owned Reaction registry for attack-hit Shield and damage-triggered Hellish Rebuke windows; falling-state reactions and additional trigger families remain incomplete.

ready.implementation: Ready spends the Action and can store a weapon attack that triggers as a Reaction before the next player turn; readied spells and item actions remain deferred.

search.implementation: Prompts Search-style checks and persists target/location discovery state after roll resolution; hidden-content generation, repeated-search DC changes, and map-square search granularity remain incomplete.

shove.implementation: Shove uses Attack action option and target save.

study.implementation: Prompts Study-style Investigation/Insight checks and persists target object/NPC knowledge state after roll resolution; exact lore reveals, secret taxonomy, and skill-family expansion remain incomplete.

utilize.implementation: Basic present-object interactions can update object and carried-inventory state before narration; locked objects and known armed traps can now create server-owned Thieves' Tools checks, while complex item activations, tool tasks, trap effects, and magic items remain incomplete.

opportunity_attack.implementation: Enemy and player melee Opportunity Attacks resolve through Reaction windows or prepared Reaction attacks, including resumable movement and Shield/Hellish Rebuke interactions.

object_interaction.implementation: Spatial guard checks presence; take/open/close/read/use basics update object_states and inventory_state before DM narration; locked objects and known traps use object challenge state before opening; full equipment, container contents, triggered trap effects, and item-effect rules remain incomplete.
